name: Debug Transition
helpText:
Set a breakpoint on data as it moves between components.

Note: debug elements are not saved when the project closes.
allowableProperties_comment: Note that the order of properties in this file dictates the order displayed on screen, unless propertyDisplayOrder is set, which will be used as the primary key

componentName.helpText: For a debug element, this will be the name of the component into which the debug flows.
